{{Otheruses|Pure Sabacc}}
[[File:Sabacc_naboo.jpg|thumb|250px|A Pure Sabacc hand comprising the Queen of Air and Darkness, the 5 of Coins, the 6 of Staves, and the Master of Coins]]
'''Pure Sabacc''' was the term used to describe a hand of exactly positive or negative twenty-three in the card game [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. When a player achieved Pure Sabacc, they received both the [[Hand pot/Legends|hand pot]] and [[Sabacc pot/Legends|sabacc pot]], and this would generally signify the end of a game. In some variations of the game, Pure Sabacc was bested by the [[Idiot's Array/Legends|Idiot's Array]].<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> The phrase was also slang referring to the perfection of a situation or object.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] held a Pure Sabacc when he won the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]].

A related term was Pure [[Pazaak/Legends|Pazaak]], which [[Atton Rand]] used as a slang term similar to Pure Sabacc.
